thread:
maria_cs: Hey team — prepping Springboard preview rollout for 10 customers tomorrow. Quick ops checklist: SSO invites, staging API keys, seat assignments, enablement session, renewal-risk tagging. Can folks confirm SSO domains and whether we have per-cust staging keys or a shared preview key? Need EOD. :wave:

alex_se: I can own staging API keys + quotas. Prefer per-customer keys so we can trace usage, but that needs extra setup.

maria_cs: Per-customer keys ideal. How long to provision 10 keys?

alex_se: ~30–45m once I have the domain list. If we go shared key I can do it in 10m.

sam_support: SSO invites queued. Domains I have so far: acme.com, zephyr.ai, cinder.net, nibble.dev. One invite to "contact@cinder.net" bounced (user not found).

maria_cs: Thanks @sam_support — can you re-request with their alternate alias? I dropped a Notion link with primary contacts: https://redwood.notionsite/springboard-preview (internal)

todd_pm: I'll run the enablement session Tue 11am PT. Draft agenda: product demo (20m), integration checklist (15m), Q&A (25m). Want me to add a short pre-read?

maria_cs: Yes please — 5-slide pre-read w/ SSO steps + token expiry note.

jin_re: Heads-up: Acme flagged as medium-high renewal risk during discovery (they have a heavy on-prem data flow). Recommend prioritize a follow-up to confirm network/VPC expectations.

maria_cs: Noted. Please add renewal-risk tag to Acme and attach the discovery notes.

preview-bot: Created group "springboard-preview" and provisioned 12 seats (IDs: s-pb-01..s-pb-12).

alex_se: Provisioned per-customer keys v1: acme-key-01, zephyr-key-01, cinder-key-01, nibble-key-01. Shared key fallback: springboard-preview-shared (expires in 72h).

sam_support: Re-sent invite to "eng@cinder.net" — confirmed. Also created calendar invites for enablement; Todd, you got them?

todd_pm: Yep got them, accepted. I'll include the pre-read in the invite and ask customers to run the health-check script before the call:

```
#!/bin/bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://staging.redwood/api/v1/health
```

maria_cs: Perfect. Last ask: QA on streaming behavior in staging — @alex_se can you run a quick smoke test after keys are wired? If anything flakey, fallback to smaller batch size and note it in the rollout doc.

alex_se: On it. Will report by 19:30 PT.

maria_cs: Awesome — thank you everyone. I'll post the final checklist in the channel and ping legal on the temporary NDA waiver for the preview. :white_check_mark: :party:
